description_en: Queries the list of protected IP addresses for a single Anti-DDoS Origin instance
description_zh: 查询单个DDoS原生防护实例的防护IP列表
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp describe-pack-ip-list --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --ip 47.98.XX.XX --product-name ECS --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --member-uid 1708588696790000 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePackIpList

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of protected IP addresses to return on each page. The maximum value is 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含受保护IP的数量。最大值：50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The protected IP address to query
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The type of the cloud asset to which the protected IP address belongs. Valid values:

ECS: an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.

SLB: a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.

EIP: an Elastic IP Address (EIP) instance. Because Application Load Balancer (ALB) instances use EIPs, query the public IP address of an ALB instance using the EIP.

WAF: a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的受保护IP所属云资产类型。取值：

ECS：表示云服务器ECS实例。
SLB：表示传统型负载均衡CLB（原SLB）实例。
EIP：表示弹性公网IP实例。因公网应用型负载均衡ALB实例使用弹性公网IP，您需要通过EIP实例查询ALB的公网IP。
WAF：表示Web应用防火墙实例
parameters.name: product_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html to query the IDs of all regions that Anti-DDoS Origin supports
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The UID of the member account
parameters.name: member_uid
